items.title: Long-time Ceres CEO Mindy Lubber to step down in 2027
items.summary: Sustainability nonprofit Ceres is seeking a successor to Mindy Lubber, who is stepping down as its long-time president and CEO at the end of 2027 after more than two decades of leadership.

items.title: Sustainability leadership moves
items.summary: As corporate sustainability matures, some long-time leaders are leaving the profession, while others are tackling a broader set of responsibilities following reorganizations or layoffs.

items.title: What sellers really think about supplier engagement programs
items.summary: As companies struggle to decarbonize supply chains, programs that help suppliers cut emissions have become a must-have component of climate strategies.

items.title: TWO WEEKS LEFT to nominate for edie’s 30 Under 30 Class of 2027
items.summary: Know a young professional making an impact and driving sustainable progress in their business? Nominations for edie’s 30 Under 30 Class of 2027 close on 16 October.

items.title: COP31 Action Tracker: UNGA updates, electrification pledge and Germany maps fossil-fuel exit
items.summary: With COP31 in Türkiye under six weeks ago, this regular members-only series from edie will provide a temperature check on global climate action.

items.title: FCA ditches mandatory sustainability reporting for UK businesses
items.summary: The Financial Conduct Authority (FCA) has published its finalised rules for listed companies, establishing a 'comply or explain' approach in place of fully mandatory reporting.

items.title: SPEAKERS ANNOUNCED: What SMEs need to know before investing in solar
items.summary: Two expert speakers have been confirmed for an upcoming edie webinar exploring how SMEs can overcome the financial and practical barriers to onsite solar and maximise the return on their investment.
